title: Mopshop Distribution IPO Details
intro:
Mopshop Distribution IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹27.26 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.16 crore shares aggregating to ₹22.08 crores and offer for sale of 0.04 crore shares aggregating to ₹5.18 crores.

Mopshop Distribution IPO opens for subscription on Aug 19, 2026 and closes on Aug 21, 2026. The allotment for the Mopshop Distribution IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 24, 2026. Mopshop Distribution IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 26, 2026.

Mopshop Distribution IPO is set final issue price at ₹138 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,76,000 (2,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,14,000.

Khandwala Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Cameo Corporate Services Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Mopshop Distribution IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

The company serves an extensive and diversified client base, spanning across various industries like Banking, Financials and Insurance (BFSI), construction and real estate, healthcare and also caters to the needs and requirements of various facility management companies with an operational footprint across multiple geographical locations and a growing roster of over 300 clients across India.

Product Portfolio includes cleaning and hygiene consumables: Microfiber cloths, Surface Disinfectants, Sensor-based Dispensers, Bio-degraadable Garbage Bags, Tissue Papers, Pedal Bins, Wringer Buckets, Vacuum Cleaners, Air Fresheners, Tool Kits, and related accessories - engineered for functionality, durability, and affordability.

The company distributes its offerings through its customised digital infrastructure by way of an Online Order Management platform developed through a third-party service provider and dedicated business development team.

faqs.question: How to apply in Mopshop Distribution IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Mopshop Distribution IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Mopshop Distribution IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Mopshop Distribution IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Mopshop Distribution IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Mopshop Distribution IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Mopshop Distribution IPO opens on Wed, Aug 19, 2026 and closes on Fri, Aug 21, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Mopshop Distribution IPO?
faqs.answer: Mopshop Distribution IPO lot size is 1000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,76,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Mopshop Distribution IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Mopshop Distribution IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Mopshop Distribution IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Mopshop Distribution IPO will be done on Monday, August 24, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Aug 25, 2026 . Check the Mopshop Distribution IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Mopshop Distribution IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Mopshop Distribution IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Aug 26, 2026 .
